scripts.build:libs: npm run build -w @puppy-track/common && npm run build -w @puppy-track/db
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build -w @puppy-track/backend && npm run build -w @puppy-track/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @puppy-track/common && npm run typecheck -w @puppy-track/db && npm run typecheck -w @puppy-track/backend && npm run typecheck -w @puppy-track/frontend
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run typecheck
